next_step: Start 4-week Dedicated POC + canary routing runbook; schedule infra kickoff
notes:
Overview: Olive Harbor is a mid-market CX SaaS (ticketing + automated assist). Evaluating Hosted API first for quick integration; shifting to Dedicated after POC to meet SLOs and data isolation needs. They want a predictable unit cost and route-level visibility.

Key contacts: CTO (Aisha Patel) - product/infra decisions; Head of ML (Ravi Menon) - model & latency requirements; VP Ops (Claire D.) - procurement/budget. AE: Maya Chen; SE: Diego Ramos.

Timeline & activity (bulleted):
- 2026-02-10: Initial discovery call (Maya + Aisha). High-level use-cases captured: auto-assist, triage, knowledge base search.
- 2026-02-18: Hosted API demo (Maya + Diego). Live transcript: ff_9182-meet-20260302. Team liked streaming + function-calling demo.
- 2026-02-25: Security questionnaire submitted; follow-ups on retention and KMS.
- 2026-03-03: Pricing workshop (prelim) — mid-market pricing tier fits but need dedicated pricing for reserve GPUs for 99th p99 targets.
- 2026-03-09: Dedicated POC kickoff call; agreed on 4-week POC focused on inference cost/latency, and canary + fallback routing plan. Demo recording: ff_9247-demo-20260309.
- 2026-03-10: Infra sync — VPC peering dates tentatively 2026-03-20. Jira RINF-4199 opened for peering assistance.

POC goals / success criteria:
- Meet 99th-percentile latency <= 250ms for short chat messages (<=256 tokens) at baseline throughput of 80 QPS.
- End-to-end token cost reduction target ~25% vs Hosted run using quantized model variant and caching.
- Zero sensitive data persisted outside customer VPC; KMS for keys.
- Observability: per-route token & latency dashboards + alerting on regressions.
- Canary signal: error rate < 0.5%, latency delta < 20% vs baseline. Rollback plan verified in runbook.

Technical requirements & preferences:
- Preferred base models: open model family (Llama variants / Falcon-like) — want Redwood-verified perf profiles.
- Need model variants: full-precision for high-quality replies, int8-quantized variant for cost trials; fallback to smaller model (e.g., 7B) under load.
- Routing: policy-driven routing by latency budget + cost (region aware). Must support region failover (NA primary, EU for EU customers) with graceful KV-cache warming.
- Batching & cache: recommend auto-batching + prefix/KV caching for sessioned chat to meet cost targets.
- Security: SSO/SAML integration required, SOC2 evidence needed, audit logs retained 1 year, EU data residency for EU customer subset.

Canary + fallback routing plan (agreed POC approach):
- Canary stage (week 1): route 5% of traffic to Dedicated canary cluster with int8 quantized model variant. Monitor latency/quality metrics and token cost.
- Expand canary (week 2): if canary meets thresholds, scale to 25% with canary handling low-risk routes (background summarization, low-confidence triage).
- Fallback routing: automatic fallback to Hosted API or smaller model variant when Dedicated capacity drops or error spike > 1%. Region failover configured: NA -> EU -> fallback Hosted (different cloud) if region outage detected.
- Rollback: automated policy to cut traffic to 0% to canary within 30s and drain in-flight requests; manual rollback checklist in runbook for quality regressions.

POC deliverables:
- Configured Dedicated environment in customer VPC (or peered network) + sample routing policies.
- Canary runbook + automated monitor dashboards (latency, errors, token/cost).
- Cost comparison report: Hosted vs Dedicated at measured QPS and perf tuning notes.
- Security sign-off artifacts: SOC2 evidence, KMS integration logs, audit log sample.

Stakeholder quotes / paraphrases:
- "If we can get predictable 99p latency and a 20-30% cost win, Dedicated makes sense." — Aisha (CTO)
- "Primary blocker is procurement slot for GPUs; need clear ARR numbers to justify reserved capacity." — Claire (VP Ops)

Next steps (short):
- 2026-03-15: infra & peering window confirmation (Olive Harbor infra team).
- 2026-03-17: send POC SOW + Dedicated pricing appendix (Maya).
- 2026-03-20: start canary config deploy (SE led: Diego) pending peering.

Open questions / blockers:
- Exact token retention policy for EU-only subset (legal sign-off pending).
- Final procurement approval for 12-month reserved capacity vs 6-month trial.
- Need Redwood to provide quantized perf numbers on target hardware (NVIDIA A10/A30) for 13B-style models.

Signals to win:
- Security questionnaire fully signed and KMS validated.
- POC achieves cost and 99p latency targets for chat flows.
- Product team signs off on model quality (A/B eval on sampled conversation set).

CRM notes style: short bullets, shorthand, some call transcript references, task-oriented. See linked docs for pricing SOW and security answers.
